newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Przymierze to launch two new funds by Sept.
newsitem.headline: Polish Przymierze to launch two new funds by Sept.

text.p: The Polish-U.S. mutual fund company Przymierze Towarzystwo Funduszy Powierniczych SA plans to launch a debt instruments fund and a second aggressive fund by September this year, the company's marketing director said.

Pawel Olbrych told a news conference the company would submit adequate applications to the Polish Securities Commission in the next few weeks and said the funds could be launched before summer holidays or by September at the latest.
"The second share fund we be something new on the Polish market, its investment method would be new, but I can't give any details now," he said.
Przymierze is 51-percent owned by Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA, while the U.S.'s Alliance Capital Management LP has 49 percent.
Przymierze now runs a balanced fund and will start its first aggressive fund on April 14.
